notes: One-Line Diagram rebuilt to match real fire alarm riser drawings: circuits render as wrapped horizontal lines (not boxes) with individually labeled devices, floor dividers, and touching EOL/no-EOL terminus symbols. Add multiple named sheets per project and export them combined into one PDF with a logo cover page. Circuits can chain box-to-box (isolator-to-isolator) or T-tap off an isolator, and Class A circuits now show explicit OUT/RETURN wires you control per-box instead of an ambiguous loop symbol. Every connector is draggable, stays perfectly horizontal/vertical, and can be reshaped with added waypoints. Added device and sheet-level notes, a show/hide toggle for all loading (mA/%) readouts, and an on-screen alignment grid that never appears in exports. Also: Candela Load Summary in the takeoff Excel export is now nested by area/section, and a toolbar Candela selector lets you batch-count devices at one rating without right-clicking each one.
